purpose: verified-4.1: reviewed bioactivity records of three species whose MBPI stays withheld, kept as partial evidence so the page shows what was found and which step is missing (team-lead request 2026-10-04 to check every '미확인' item). None of them enters a score. 4.1: the 꽃게 record left this file — the origin species was settled on public sequence records and it now carries a score in the AMP stratum. 4.3 (2026-10-05): the 참조기 XO record left this file — its peptides are scored in the new XO stratum (evidence-xo-4.3-2026-10-05.json). Three 갑오징어 records were added: each fails two or more conditions, so the one-condition relaxation (prereg-fill-all-4.3 1.4) does not apply and the species keeps the floor MBPI; they show what was found. The 참문어 Zhou 2025 record was re-read in full text (still no single MIC), and a cephalotocin record was added; neither scores. 4.4 (2026-10-05): the 참문어 cephalotocin record left this file — its East-Asian origin is settled on the Octopus sinensis reference genome and it is scored under relaxation (d) (evidence-relaxed-4.4-2026-10-05.json). Four records were added from the 2026-10-05 re-search: one for 방어 (the first potency number tied to its own tissue, a crude fraction) and three for 갑오징어. Each fails two or more conditions, so neither species leaves the floor.
